blocks.text: The Purview DC team connects infrastructure engineering, GPU deployment, commissioning and operations into one delivery approach.
Four platforms our own engineers run on
Every one of these started as a tool we needed on a live build. They are now available to clients and partners through Purview DC.

items.title: Data Center Deployer
items.body: Dock-to-rack delivery platform: technician app, coordinator control tower, rack elevation and digital twin.

items.title: SmartWorkforce
items.body: AI workflow platform that turns SOPs into device-ready guidance: connect, collaborate, guide, solve.

items.title: SmartInspect
items.body: Wearable-led remote collaboration: AR annotations, 4K streaming, smart glasses, session reporting and digital auditing.

items.title: SmartAMM
items.body: AI-powered asset management and monitoring: sensors to edge hubs to AI analytics to digital twin dashboards.
